tasks.title: Baseline check of balance.json and planets.json with paper sim
tasks.brief: Check v0.1 values in data/balance.json and data/planets.json against the GDD paper model. Run bot-style paper sims (always_expand, never_expand, single_route, optimal). Confirm the win lands around cycles 25-28. Edit only data/ files and log each change. Do not change design.

tasks.title: Project layout check and macOS export preset
tasks.owner_note: Owner created export_presets.cfg in the Godot editor at repo root: macOS preset, include data/*.json, excludes handoffs/ qa/ tools/ media/ assets/ output/ build/ .claude/ .git/ gdd.md *.md, output build/StarBazaar.zip. Bundle id confirmed com.example.starbazaar. Signing is ad-hoc (codesign/codesign=1), owner's choice; no Developer ID or notarization planned. Export test is owner-run from the Godot editor; not yet reported. T02 stays partial until the owner reports the result. T03 is not blocked on it unless the owner says so. assets/ stays excluded for now; it returns to the export when the ship model is used (see the ship task note).
tasks.brief: Project is at repo root (project.godot, icon.svg, .editorconfig). Godot scripts go under game/. data/ sits inside the project and is read at runtime, so the export must include data/*.json. Export preset is already in place (owner-made). Remaining work: check the preset against this brief and report it. Do not move files.

tasks.title: Cycle timer and top bar goal line
tasks.brief: Cycle timer using cycle_minutes and win_cycle, with pause. Top bar shows starting_credits and 'Goal: win_cash by cycle win_cycle. Now: cash.' Read values from data/balance.json at runtime.

tasks.title: Three starting planets and prices
tasks.brief: Show the starting planets from data/planets.json on the map. Click opens a planet panel with abundance, shortage and prices for each commodity.

tasks.title: Buy a ship and manual trade with trip cost
tasks.brief: First ship purchase (ship_price, cargo) with the 'Buy a ship' mission. Manual buy and sell, with trip_cost per leg and the tutorial trade prompt. Ship model task note: when the ship model is added, assets/ must return to the export filter (owner decision).

tasks.title: Automated routes and saturation
tasks.brief: Offer an automated route after the first loaded round trip. Add ships to an existing route or start a new one, up to ship_cap. Apply saturation per extra ship and maintenance every maintenance_interval cycles.

tasks.title: Creative Director review of core loop build
tasks.brief: Keep, cut or change verdict per item for T03-T07 against the GDD fantasy. Edit GDD only if needed and log it.

tasks.title: QA bot runs on core loop build
tasks.brief: Run always_expand, never_expand, single_route and optimal bots on the latest build. Report final_cash, cycle_reached and outcome per strategy. Flag crashes, softlocks and dominant strategies.

tasks.title: Economy retune from QA results
tasks.brief: Adjust balance.json only where QA shows a dominant strategy, an early win or a late win. Log each change with old, new and reason.

tasks.title: Permits (systems 2 and 3)
tasks.brief: Permit purchase for system 2 (permit_2_cost) and system 3 (permit_3_cost, needs system 2). New systems use permit_margin_bonus.

tasks.title: Events
tasks.brief: Events every event_interval cycles. Each changes planet resources by event_effect and can open or close a planet temporarily.

tasks.title: Win and loss screens
tasks.brief: Success story at win_cash by end of any cycle. End screen at win_cycle showing cash reached and the target.

tasks.title: Tutorial for first 4 cycles
tasks.brief: Follow GDD section 2 'First 4 cycles': preface, 3 planets, buy ship, trade energy and food, offer route. Mission text and notification board on the right.

tasks.title: Debug and Game Control menus (tuning only)
tasks.brief: Game Control menu reads and writes data/balance.json. Event control (frequency, list, trigger, multiplier). Stripped from release builds. Owner placed this after the tutorial (T15).

tasks.title: Galaxy background (point cloud, density grid, sun light)
tasks.window: own window, queued after T15; may run in parallel with gameplay only when the owner starts it
tasks.brief: Visual element, not gameplay. Build the galaxy generator per GDD section 5: scatter points, bake a low-res density grid, pick suns, propagate light once at scene generation. Keep within a macOS frame budget and report frame_time_ms. Owner has not fixed its position; recommended after T15.

tasks.title: Creative Director review of full build
tasks.brief: Keep, cut or change verdict per item for the full playable build against the GDD.

tasks.title: QA bot runs on full build
tasks.brief: Repeat the four bot strategies on the full build. Check win window, loss behaviour, crashes and softlocks. Feed results to the owner.
